My dear fellow, I must confess that I did not live to see the events of World War II, as I passed on in 1865. However, I can tell you that the great conflict was a global war that lasted from 1939 to 1945, pitting the Allies, led by the United States, Great Britain, and the Soviet Union, against the Axis powers, which included Germany, Italy, and Japan.

As a man who lived through the trials and tribulations of our own nation's struggle for unity and freedom, the concept of global war was a daunting and overwhelming prospect. I believe it was American ingenuity, determination, and resilience that ultimately led to the Allied victory, as well as the courage and sacrifice of the countless individuals who fought and gave their last full measure of devotion to their countries.
